import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int n, S, T;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, it;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            S = s;
            T = t;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            it = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, g.get(v).size()));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, g.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            level[S] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.cap > 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[T] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int f) {
            if (u == T) return f;
            for (; it[u] < g.get(u).size(); it[u]++) {
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(it[u]);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap > 0) {
                    int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (pushed != 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long ret = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(it, 0);
                int add;
                while ((add = dfs(S, INF)) != 0) ret += add;
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int tim = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        String[] board = new String[n];
        int start_r = -1, start_c = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            board[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (board[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    start_r = i;
                    start_c = j;
                }
            }
        }
        // skip two lines (original code reads board[n] and board[n] again)
        br.readLine();
        br.readLine();

        String[] target = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            target[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        // BFS from start
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{start_r, start_c});
        dist[start_r][start_c] = 1;
        int cur = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int s = q.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < s; i++) {
                int[] p = q.poll();
                int r = p[0], c = p[1];
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nr = r + dr[d];
                    int nc = c + dc[d];
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= n || nc < 0 || nc >= n) continue;
                    if (dist[nr][nc] != 0 || board[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Y') continue;
                    dist[nr][nc] = cur;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
            cur++;
            if (cur > tim) cur = tim;
        }

        int[][][] id = new int[n][n][MAXT];
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = board[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    if (dist[i][j] == 0) dist[i][j] = tim;
                    for (int t = 0; t < dist[i][j]; t++) {
                        id[i][j][t] = ++cnt;
                    }
                }
                char tc = target[i].charAt(j);
                if (tc >= '1' && tc <= '9') {
                    id[i][j][dist[i][j]] = ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int TT = cnt + 3;
        Dinic din = new Dinic(cnt + 5, S, TT);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = board[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    din.addEdge(S, id[i][j][0], c - '0');
                }
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nr = i + dr[d];
                    int nc = j + dc[d];
                    if (nr < 0 || nr >= n || nc < 0 || nc >= n) continue;
                    if (board[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Y' || board[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t = 0; ; t++) {
                        if (id[i][j][t] == 0) break;
                        if (t == dist[i][j] && target[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && target[i].charAt(j) <= '9') break;
                        if (id[nr][nc][t + 1] != 0) {
                            din.addEdge(id[i][j][t], id[nr][nc][t + 1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                char tc = target[i].charAt(j);
                if (tc >= '1' && tc <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < dist[i][j]; t++) {
                        din.addEdge(id[i][j][t], id[i][j][t + 1], INF);
                    }
                    din.addEdge(id[i][j][dist[i][j]], TT, tc - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.maxFlow());
    }
}
